text:
maya: Hey team — putting together backstage protocols for Thursday's webinar. Need final run-of-show handoff + attendee routing. Quick sync?

 tom: Yes. Key ask: who owns live demo fallback (pre-record) and where do we route attendees during failover?

 eli: Ops owns failover-dual, but marketing needs the lead routing map. I'll draft routing rules.

 sophia: I'll confirm the pre-record clip is uploaded to S3 and short link ready. Also need the cue script for the MC.

 maya: Thanks. For routing I want:
 - critical bugs -> eng-oncall Slack
 - demo issues -> ops (ops-bot)
 - general Qs -> #webinar-questions channel
 - leads -> SFDC queue "webinar_inbound_apr2026"

 eli: Sounds good. Can we gate traffic so heavy demo load doesn't overload demo GPU? Plan is to throttle demo connections after 500 concurrent.

 tom: Throttle rule noted. ops-bot will post metrics and cutover if latency > 500ms for 30s.

 ops-bot: [automated] demo-throttle policy deployed to staging: threshold=500conns, latency_cutoff=500ms, cooldown=60s

 sophia: MC cue script draft:
 - 00:00 intro
 - 06:30 demo intro
 - 07:15 handoff to engineer
 - 12:00 fallback to pre-record if engineer reports FAIL

 maya: Add explicit hand signals for stage ops: 1 finger = slow down, 2 = swap to pre-record, red card = stop audio.

 eli: For lead routing the exact mapping in SFDC: source=webinar, campaign=April-Infer-Launch, owner=null -> round-robin to SDR pool.

 tom: Who's listed as backup for the engineer demo? I can step in but need a 10min dry-run.

 sophia: Backup is @eli, second backup @tom. Dry-run scheduled Wed 16:00 PT.

 maya: Final checklist:
 - pre-record uploaded + tested
 - ops-bot policies live
 - SFDC mappings confirmed
 - MC script printed
 - Dry-run done

 eli: I'll open a tiny playbook in Google Drive and paste links in the thread after dry-run.

 maya: Perfect. Please @mention me when playbook is ready. :thumbsup:

 ops-bot: [reminder] Dry-run reminder scheduled for 2026-04-07T23:00:00Z

 tom: Got it. Will bring backup laptop + local recording

 sophia: Confirmed. See you all Wed.
